# Agent Framework

> TypeScript/Node.js framework for building production AI agents. The model requests actions; deterministic code authorizes, executes, limits and audits them. Provider-independent (Claude, OpenAI-compatible, local models), with tool calling, human approval, RAG, memory, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, MCP, sandboxed tools, OpenTelemetry observability, evaluation and a durable production runtime. Monorepo of 15 packages under @agent-farmework/*. Apache-2.0. Status: 0.x. Published to GitHub Packages (registry https://npm.pkg.github.com, scope @agent-farmework; needs a token with read:packages); also runnable from source.

Key facts:
- Entry points: defineAgent + createRuntime (@agent-farmework/core), defineTool + ToolRuntime (@agent-farmework/tools).
- Runs never throw for model/tool failures; check result.status (COMPLETED, FAILED, WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL, CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT, APPROVAL_EXPIRED).
- Tool calls require the permission on both the agent and the user; approvals are bound to exact arguments and resumed with agent.resume().
- Offline testing: createScriptedProvider / createRuleProvider from @agent-farmework/core/testing.
- Commands: pnpm install, pnpm check, pnpm examples.

## Guides
- [Agents](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/agents.md): defineAgent, run, limits, streaming, structured output, approvals, recovery
- [Tools](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/tools.md): defineTool, ToolRuntime pipeline, permissions, approval, retries, idempotency, audit
- [Models](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/models.md): Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible adapters, streaming, model router, fallback
- [Skills](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/skills.md): reusable capabilities
- [Context](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/context.md): token budgets and context assembly
- [Knowledge / RAG](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/knowledge.md): knowledge bases, hybrid search, citations
- [Memory](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/memory.md): policy-driven memory with ownership and TTL
- [Planning](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/planning.md), [Orchestration](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/orchestration.md), [Multi-agent](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/multi-agent.md)
- [Reflection](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/reflection.md): verifiers and correction loops
- [Security](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/security.md) and [Guardrails](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/guardrails.md)
- [MCP](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/mcp.md) and [Sandbox tools](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/sandbox.md)
- [Observability](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/observability.md): OpenTelemetry, cost tracking, dashboard
- [Evaluation](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/evaluation.md): datasets, evaluators, regression tests
- [Production](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/production.md): durable state, queues, workers, PostgreSQL/SQLite/pgvector/Redis
- [CLI](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/cli.md): agent create/dev/test/evaluate/inspect/trace/dashboard/validate
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): error codes and fixes

## Examples
- [hello-agent](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/examples/hello-agent/index.ts): minimal agent with a tool
- [rag-agent](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/examples/rag-agent/index.ts): retrieval with citations
- [research-agent](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/examples/research-agent/index.ts): planning and typed report
- [orchestrator](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/examples/orchestrator/index.ts): parallel workers
- [approval-agent](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/examples/approval-agent/index.ts): human-in-the-loop
- [enterprise-agent](https://github.com/agent-farmework/agents-framework/blob/main/examples/enterprise-agent/index.ts): everything combined
